composition.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full redraw of Satanael for a fictional Persona 5 Royal game mod, landscape 4:3, transparent PNG. This is a static cel-shaded game sprite draft.
REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 is v8 and is ONLY the framing, stance, camera, limb placement, depth and wing curl reference. Do not copy its face, armor inventions, or revolver. Images 2–4 are ACTUAL PS0170 model renders and authoritative for design: 2 helmet, 3 front body and six wings, 4 two crops of the original complete long gun and grip. Image 5 is the original gameplay shot mirrored to the desired screen direction, for dramatic angle only; omit its blue lighting, halo, fog, HUD and stage.
POSE/FRAMING: match image 1's low-angle view from Satanael's right front, looking upward. Slender body occupies left third, turning toward screen right, head around (22%,34%), thighs through mid-thigh at bottom. He extends one gun arm from his shoulder directly toward camera and screen right; hand around (37%,39%) and complete visible muzzle near (92%,15%) with breathing room. Strong depth along barrel toward upper right, the muzzle aperture visible as a small ellipse; the original thin barrel remains narrow along its whole length. His own left hand grasps the gold handle properly in the mirrored pose, palm around rear grip, index at trigger, wrist behind and below the receiver. Other arm hidden by body/wings. Six huge wing panels curl forward around the body as in v8; the nearest extends beneath and toward the gun. Head and two ram horns readable, space above head reserved for a separate halo.
HELMET: exactly the original model design in image 2, a compact DARK blue-black plated helmet with two small upright BAT-EAR points on top and a separate pair of massive thick RAM HORNS from the sides curving down, inward and forward in almost a ring, with feather pattern on inside of horn curves and original gold bands. The dark pointed lower faceplate is an angular BIRD BEAK, gold trim around small glowing eye slits. No skin, white face, humanoid facial features, mouth, teeth, grin, or upward antler replacement.
WINGS: precisely six distinct massive scythe-shaped dark wing blades, three stacked on each side, directly model-shaped, not a single feather fan. Separate the three left silhouettes with clear notches, three right tiers overlapping in depth, with curved near panels filling the lower-right. Retain the characteristic broad rich gold panels with dark skull motifs on the wing blades, original small star bands and small red accents as in image 3. Do not wash out the gold or make the wings plain black.
WEAPON: the same unusual very long very SLIM fantasy gun of image 4, with its thin black-and-gold rail-like barrel, angular rectangular body, conspicuous radial gold FAN / sunburst ornament around the middle, original curling gold trigger guard and gold grip, tip completely in frame. NO revolver cylinder, chamber drum, bolt gun stock, extra barrels or thick cannon casing. Visually unmistakable long original prop even in foreshortened perspective.
BODY: original sleek slender dark armor, dark blue-black feathered textures simplified to ink, gold hardware, red necktie/chest strip, studded belt and slim bent thighs with gold skull armor and gold trim. Keep original black, gold and red palette in neutral lighting. Persona 5 cel-shaded illustration, bold clean black ink contours and two hard shading steps, crisp graphic edges. Clear complete silhouette and high native resolution. True transparent RGBA empty areas and solid character. No halo, no baked effects, no scene, no haze, no text or watermark.

assembly: Twelve separately generated square tiles, each downsampled to its placement rectangle. Alignment uses the scaled composition for guidance only. No composition pixels enter the sprite. Adjacent tiles are blended along minimum-difference overlap cuts, with a wider transition for low-frequency tones inside solid shapes.

visual_review_zh.造型: 按原版模型确认深色蝙蝠耳头盔、向下前弯的羊角、鸟喙面甲和金色眼缘。左右各三片翼，保留金色骷髅图案、细长枪和金色扇饰、正手握法、红领带及带纹样的腿甲。
visual_review_zh.差异: 硬边绘法简化了翼面骷髅和金属反光，枪柄比模型参考更方、更显眼，头盔额缘银色高光略强。近翼有少量局部色调变化，右下翼尖贴到画布边缘。
visual_review_zh.草图阶段: 整图生成一次，整图重画零次，随后完成十二块原生重绘拼接。使用既有模型参考渲染，未启动 Blender。草图尚未拆层。
